name: HD2

images.credit: Electzik, CC BY-SA 3.0 via Wikimedia Commons

Network.Technology: Quadband GSM / GPRS, EDGE and dual band WCDMA, HSDPA, HSUPA

Body.Dimensions: 120.5 x 67 x 11 mm, (4.74 x 2.64 x 0.43 in), (T-Mobile US version, 122 x 67 x 11 mm)
Body.Weight: 162 g (5.54 oz), (157 g T-Mobile US version)

Platform.Operating system: Official: Windows Mobile 6.5 Professional, Unofficial: Windows Phone, Android, Firefox OS, Windows RT, MeeGo, Ubuntu, iOS
Platform.CPU: 1 GHz single-core Qualcomm Scorpion processor, (Snapdragon S1 QSD8250 chipset)
Platform.GPU: Adreno 200 (AMD Z430) with OpenGL ES 2.0 support

Memory.RAM: 512MB internal flash ROM (1024MB on T-Mobile US version), 576 MB RAM , (Software is limited to using 448 MB on non-US versions)

Display.Display: 4.3 in. LCD capacitive touchscreen, 480x800 px 65k-color WVGA, back-lit TFT LCD

Cameras.Rear camera: 5 megapixels autofocus CMOS sensor, video up to 800×480 resolution

Battery.Battery: Rechargeable 1230mAh Li-ion battery (2300mAh extended battery available)(up to 490 hrs standby, 6.3 hrs talk time)
